CMFT.description: Equivalent Moment Correction Factor Cm (CMFT). Fields hold the auto-calculate flag and the manual Cm factors about the member local y and z axes.

OPT_AUTO.description: Auto Calculate. When true, Cm is computed automatically and CMY/CMZ are ignored.

CMY.description: Equivalent moment correction factor Cm about the member local y-axis. Must satisfy 0.0 <= value <= 1.0.

CMZ.description: Equivalent moment correction factor Cm about the member local z-axis. Must satisfy 0.0 <= value <= 1.0.
